objective: build and audit a 0.7 mm isotropic fixed-HU VoxTell preprocessing cache before finetuning

preprocessing.label_policy: train and val require released labels; test is image-only and missing labels are expected
preprocessing.orientation: same NibabelIOWithReorient image orientation and affine-derived target reorientation used by VoxTell caches
preprocessing.crop: crop_to_nonzero before resampling; apply the same native crop to every target
preprocessing.normalization: clip native cropped HU to [-1024,1024], divide by 1024, then resample
preprocessing.mask_interpolation: torch nearest-exact with foreground-center splat fallback if a nonempty target disappears

storage_estimate.warning: estimates are full-FOV/uncompressed; crop-to-nonzero, npz compression, and case geometry affect actual cache size

runtime_plan.full_workers: start at 8 workers; increase to 12 only if memory and storage I/O remain healthy
runtime_plan.estimated_full_runtime: 3-8 hours, possibly overnight if NFS or large cases dominate
